title: v4.0.0 · CodeQL Security Hardening
highlights: Remediate 18 recorded CodeQL alerts (14 high, 4 medium) by replacing vulnerable HTML CLI and locking down Live Panel network access
Replace third-party monolithic renderer with audited offline static HTML implementation, strict input and path boundaries
Add Code Scanning zero-open-alert publish gate and regression tests
Preserve all 294 canonical skill entry points across 16 categories
release_gates: Exact merged-main Repository Validation, provenance and CodeQL all pass
Main branch Code Scanning open alert API returns zero before publishing
Full pytest, cross-platform installer tests, provenance and generated artifacts pass
Draft release assets downloaded and verified with SHA256 and canonical skill count

validation_boundaries.upstream: Locally security-hardened adaptation; not identical to external upstream generated CLI.
validation_boundaries.runtime: Static and isolated CLI tests; no live production cloud/browser acceptance.
validation_boundaries.security: Zero open Code Scanning alerts means zero detected by configured CodeQL rules, not a formal proof of zero vulnerabilities.

breaking_changes: HTML skill serve, update, clean, auto-browser-open, voice, arbitrary local file and image embeds are disabled
HTML/SVG/complex embedded executable diagrams are rendered as escaped text or simplified flow rather than executed
